summary: The change resolves the documented terminal-mapping contradictions without introducing an actionable defect.

evidence: G2 explicitly gives G1 stop-reason mapping precedence over output shape, including keeping length stops incomplete (lines 318-322).
G1 treats absent and unrecognized reasons as fail-closed rather than completed (lines 293-302).
G3 is restricted to exactly zero output items and explicitly excludes reasoning-only output (lines 365-367).
